description: Rotates the channels of a polyphonic cable and sets how many channels come out, with a display and a CV output of the input's channel count. Superseded by Toly Pools v2.

params.text: Rotates the channels of the input, 0 to 15, so a setting of 1 sends input channel 2 out on channel 1 and so on round the sixteen channels.
Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16.

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are rotated.
Takes the rotation knob over while a cable is patched, 0.625V per channel of rotation, and a negative voltage counts down from sixteen.
Takes the output channel count knob over while a cable is patched, 0.625V per channel.

outputs.text: A voltage for the number of channels on the input, 0.625V per channel, so sixteen channels gives 10V.
